text:
You live in the dawn.

The birds acclaim you.

Joy dresses you in tunics of birds.

What dawn you exalt!

What noble light is yours!

Mornings and nights listen to you

because you are like a taper,

because you are like a roe deer.

To feel you passing,

brushing me with roses and ayes...

To ache on your knees, crushed

by crags and thickets.


And let a zephyr of larks come sweetly,

let you arrive, winnowing my wounds...

To be woman and yours, what ineffable

melting of consciousness in your arms!

translation.title: The Infinite
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the dawn-lit beloved and the ecstatic melting of consciousness.
